variants.headline: Party leader faces a public scandal
variants.body: A scandal concerning a party leader has come to light in {colony}. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: A scandal tests political trust
variants.body: A scandal about a party leader has become public in the colony. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.
